newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 4,700 slaughter steers and 2,300 heifers; 71,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,500 formulated and 2,100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 72.00. Pen Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1300 lbs 72.50. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 71.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 72.00.
Wk to Date: 71,300 Week Ago: 89,500 Year Ago: 80,600
